house_style: Muted, realistic digital painting for the background of a high school physics tool with a dark interface. Low contrast, deep blue-grey, calm and quiet. No text, no letters, no watermark, no border, no frame.
style: A physics lab bench seen from the side, dim and soft so a cart, tick marks and labels drawn on top stay readable.

assets.name: track-bench
assets.prompt: Empty background: a long dark lab bench surface seen from the front and slightly above, with a brushed aluminum air track rail running straight along its whole length, horizontal, from the left edge to the right edge. Soft overhead light makes a gentle sheen on the metal. Dark charcoal bench top, dark blurred lab wall behind. Nothing on the track: no cart, no objects, no equipment, no labels. Completely empty of people: no people, no hands, no faces. No text, no numbers, no scale markings anywhere. Muted, low contrast and dark, made to sit behind a dark user interface.
assets.local_note: shown at 40 percent opacity under a dark wash behind the track strip at the top of the stage; the tool draws its own rail, ticks, cart and sensor on top, so keep it plain, dark and even along its length, no people or hands
assets.sd: A long dark charcoal lab bench seen from the front and slightly above, a single plain brushed aluminum rail running straight and horizontal across the whole width of the picture, soft overhead light making a gentle sheen on the metal, dark blurred wall behind, minimal and empty, muted and dark.
